title: Separate lasting documentation from change review
statement: As a reviewer, I can move between lasting product documentation and the review of a specific change, so that I never confuse current truth with change discussion.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The header offers separate Documentation and Review destinations.
Pull-request reviews appear only on the Review side.
Code Diff and review coverage appear only on the Review side.
A feature, story, or criterion lists the reviews that changed its explained code.
A related-reviews list identifies itself as derived from code links.
